name: Ryan L. Truby
title: Assistant Professor; June and Donald Brewer Junior Professor
department: Materials Science and Engineering; Mechanical Engineering
fitReason: A concrete physical-learning option for a CS researcher interested in model learning, sample-efficient control and adaptation. The group is materially focused, so a software-heavy project would need deliberate agreement rather than assuming a foundation-model laboratory.

physicalEvidence.summary: June 2026 LEAP integrates learned damage representations and wrench prediction into an actual six-degree-of-freedom soft wrist on a Franka Panda, with a physical contour-tracing demonstration after actuator damage. The 2025 related study trains RL directly on a soft Stewart platform for puck balancing without simulated pretraining. Current Truby postdoc Taekyoung Kim and former group MSR student James Avtges are coauthors, linking the experiments to the group within a joint Murphey collaboration.

shortVisit.summary: The current contact page offers professional contact information but no external visiting-master’s invitation. The roster records a former visiting undergraduate, which is hosting precedent only. Summer 2027 availability is unknown.

unknowns: LEAP is learned proprioception feeding a physical task controller, not an end-to-end foundation-model action policy. Its reported single-actuator adaptation time differs from the whole-wrist data-collection and computation protocol.
In the 2025 balancing study, rapid center balancing and the longer arbitrary-target curriculum are distinct experiments. Maximum Diffusion RL should not be described as a generative diffusion policy.

Northwestern’s existing institutional review distinguishes doctoral-only VPF from Student Intern. The latter permits personal funds and compatible durations, but a graduate-inclusive application conflicts with an undergraduate-only departmental checklist. An in-progress overseas master’s route still requires explicit institutional resolution.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
